final_message:
Configured the DNS hierarchy for the existing Kathará lab. pc1–pc13 serve the authoritative zones, pc14 resolves recursively using pc1 as its root, and pc16–pc20 use pc14 as their resolver.

`www.example.com` points to pc4 because the diagram did not specify its address. The A and MX records do not install web or mail services. Startup scripts passed shell syntax checks; live DNS testing was not possible because Docker access was denied and Kathará was unavailable.

See [README.md](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-tfoxzhqc/lab/README.md) for startup requirements and verification commands.
